research.title: OpenStax College Physics2e §2.3 Time, Velocity, and Speed
research.read: Actual primary HTML: elapsed time, path/elapsed average speed vs displacement/elapsed velocity, return journey distinction.
research.licence: Actual preface https://openstax.org/books/college-physics-2e/pages/preface lines25–34 states CC BY-NC-SA4.0, not blanket CC BY. Third-party art has separate credits. No source prose/figures/code reused.
research.adopted: Distinguish totalpath and displacement; keep stops in elapsed time. Original Finnish finite examples and diagrams; no efficacy transfer.

research.title: OpenStax College Physics2e §2.4 Acceleration
research.read: Actual primary HTML: change in velocity over elapsed time, direction, and negative acceleration need not reduce speed.
research.licence: Same actual preface CC BY-NC-SA4.0 with art exceptions. Conceptual comparison only; no copied figures or long passages.
research.adopted: Compare equal-time changes and braking; scope signed1D model, distinguish direction from speed magnitude. No claims about child outcomes.

planning.scope: Finite original1D models only; signed velocity and integrated totalpath. Exact closed-form state independent of frame rate.
